name: clover
_note: Clover (Luca Metehau) is a UCI engine in C++ with NNUE eval. The NNUE file `quantised.nnue` is committed to the repo (src/) and embedded into the binary at build time — no external download needed. Perft is invoked via the top-level command `perft <depth>` (NOT `go perft`); output is three lowercase-keyed lines `nodes: N`, `time : T`, `nps  : V`. Threads + Hash setoption supported; Hash has min=2 so don't try to set it to 1.
